Before I can approve the disposal route and shipment controls, I need to walk through the review with laboratory quality, waste logistics, and warehouse supervision per our waste-authorization routine. Let's get started — can I get a read from each of you on your respective areas?

I completed the analysis yesterday on the spent coolant in those fourteen drums, and it came back at 2.4% chlorinated solvent. This result has not yet been attached to the waste authorization, so we need to account for it before any disposal route is approved.
